purpose: Fail-closed operator checklist for promoting the optional ANPOS commercial service from certified staging to production sales.

recommended_publication_path.rule: The staged path is recommended while paid eligibility evidence is missing. An operator may choose another compliant path, but repository state cannot waive GitHub Marketplace requirements or authorize paid publication.

required_gates.rule: Create vendor-private anpos-commercial-service repository and populate it only from certified exporter output.
Create vendor-private anpos-commercial-template repository and populate it only from certified exporter output.
Create the GitHub App under the intended publisher organization and store credentials only in approved secret storage.
Install GitHub App on the private commercial template with least privileges for enabled delivery modes.

Verify the app is organization-owned; an organization owner controls/submits the listing; publisher verification prerequisites include verified organization domain, confirmed contact email and organization 2FA; complete financial onboarding for paid publication.

Before paid listing submission, verify the GitHub App meets GitHub's current paid-listing installation threshold. The 2026-09-04 compliance baseline records a minimum of 100 installations; re-check official GitHub documentation before submission. A genuine free listing may be used first according to marketplace-staged-launch.json rather than fabricating threshold evidence.

Verify valid publisher contact information, relevant description, pricing plan, privacy URL, support URL/email, working relevant links, integration value beyond authentication, public availability rather than preview/invite-only, and Marketplace plan-change/cancellation webhook configuration.
Provide Marketplace-compliant logo, feature card and screenshots and verify GitHub branding/usage requirements before submission.

Configure actual Marketplace plan IDs/prices and map them to developer/pro/team/enterprise without repository-side invented billing values; for every paid plan verify monthly and annual USD pricing and an allowed Marketplace pricing model. A free-first route does not mutate these paid draft tiers automatically.
Verify the customer-facing product shows current plan/price, purchases and plan changes, cancellation/trial state, monthly-vs-annual billing cycle, and usage/remaining resources where applicable.

Verify either Marketplace free trials are disabled, or the current trial behavior is supported and private customer data from a cancelled trial is deleted within GitHub's required timeframe. The 2026-09-04 baseline records a 14-day trial and deletion within 30 days; re-check before publication.
Finalize Terms, Privacy, License/EULA, refund/cancellation, tax and support/SLA terms with appropriate legal/accounting review and ensure wording matches actual Marketplace billing/trial behavior.
Configure production DATABASE_URL, GitHub App credentials, Marketplace mapping/webhook secret, Ed25519 signing key, operator token, vendor installation/repo identifiers and issuer URL.
Allow the Marketplace webhook endpoint through deployment protection while keeping operator/admin surfaces protected.
Verify /api/ready returns HTTP 200 against production configuration and migration checksum.

Verify real purchased/changed/cancelled events plus duplicate/retry/hash-conflict behavior against production, and free-trial events when free trials are enabled. A free-only listing still requires real purchase/cancellation event evidence before publication.
Verify missed-event operator reconciliation and periodic Marketplace account/plan reconciliation against authenticated GitHub Marketplace state.
Verify entitled customer archive delivery from the vendor-private template.
Verify organization seat assign/revoke/capacity/principal-bound token refresh with a real organization.
Verify cancellation prevents future premium access without deleting, encrypting, remotely modifying or intentionally breaking generated customer repositories.
Verify production entitlement-ledger restore procedure and record current RPO/RTO evidence.
Deploy production from vendor-private source or a verified immutable artifact; do not rely on public canonical source access.

promotion_rule: Production sales are authorized only when every required paid-production gate has status=verified and evidence is recorded. Repository edits alone cannot set launch_authorized=true. Re-check blueprints/commercial/github-marketplace-compliance.json and the staged-launch strategy against official GitHub documentation immediately before Marketplace submission or paid conversion.
